name: Honda CB750 (SOHC four)
engine: 736 cc air-cooled SOHC inline four, four carbs, dry sump
intro: Honda's first big four. Four carbs, points ignition and a dry-sump engine that keeps its oil in a separate tank.
focus: Oil lives in a separate tank
Rebuilt and synced as a set

G-004.title: Rebuild the four carbs as a set
G-004.instructions: Take the carb bank off as one unit. Strip one carb at a time and keep each carb's parts in its own labeled tray. Clean every jet and passage, fit new float bowl gaskets and o-rings, set the float heights, then refit the bank.
G-004.reason: The four carbs work as one synced system. Mixing parts between them, or rebuilding only one, is how a SOHC ends up running on three.

add.title: Listen for cam chain rattle
add.instructions: Start it cold and listen at the top of the engine at idle and around 2,000 rpm. A rattle that fades as it warms points at the cam chain tensioner.
add.reason: A worn cam chain tensioner is the most common top-end noise on these engines.

add.title: Check the oil in the separate tank
add.instructions: This engine is dry sump: the oil lives in a tank under the seat, not in the crankcase. Check the level with the dipstick in the tank, the way the manual says, and look for leaks at the tank lines.
add.reason: Checking it like a wet-sump bike gives a wrong reading. Oil that seems to leak from the cases can come from the tank lines.

add.title: Check the fork sliders before fitting seals
add.instructions: Before fitting new fork seals, look inside the seal bore for scores. A seal levered out with a screwdriver in the past often scars the alloy, and oil then wicks past the new seal.
add.reason: Owners report new seals leaking on scored sliders.

A: Write down the engine number. Early K0 bikes differ from later K models in many small parts.
G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago. Check that past owners didn't skip key service instead.

known.title: Cam chain tensioner
known.what: Rattle at idle and around 2,000 rpm, loudest when cold.

known.title: Carbs that won't sync
known.what: 'Just needs the carbs cleaned' usually means a full rebuild of all four.

known.title: Scored fork sliders
known.what: New seals leak if an old seal was pried out and scratched the alloy.
